name: 70148 · New Orleans, LA
findings: ZIP 70148 (New Orleans) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (86% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70148 (New Orleans) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
